title: Network Planning Engineer
desc:
What We're Looking For
Graduated from Electrical-Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering or Mathematics Departments of Universities or a related field
Min. 3 years of experience
Preferably CCNP certificate holder or CCNP level technical knowledge
Advanced knowledge of WAN-LAN-INTERNET technologies
Proficient in MPLS VPN-L3VPN-L2VPN-GetVPN-DMVPN
Proficient in DHCP, ARP, Spoofing, Spanning Tree terminologies
Advanced knowledge of Data Center Network Management
Good experience with Cisco data center Nexus products
Knowledgeable in Python programming language and knowledge of scripting applications
Knowledge and experience in Cisco ACI, Vmware NSX products
Preferably technical knowledge in security products such as Load-Balancer, DDOS, WAF, SSLVPN
Information about Network structures of financial institutions (BKM-KKB-IMKB-Mastercard-Swift-Bloomberg etc.)
What You'll Do
To ensure the installation and operation of Switch, Router, WLC, Packet Broker, QoS Appliance, NAC products in the bank network infrastructure
To design and implement IP planning and necessary network architecture, which are the responsibility of the team
To prepare technical network documents
To understand internal and external customer needs and to make planning and guidance accordingly
To make operational decisions regarding the areas of duty
To represent the company/group/department/team within and outside the company when necessary
To ensure system continuity in extraordinary situations regarding the areas of responsibility of the team
To carry out duties in accordance with ITIL processes
To lead POC and Test activities
To have knowledge about the products under responsibility, to play an active role in the development of the product
To take the necessary actions to comply with the deadlines specified in the project plan, to foresee possible risks and to inform and escalate to the managers and project team when necessary
Why Intertech

📔 Continuous learning and development opportunities by working with experts and training facilities via Inter Academy,
